decisions.decision: accepted on the whole-stream verify match at +21 ms; the first-16 forward prediction failed and is never cited as the basis
decisions.reasoning: The whole-stream verify (all 60,835 frames matched at +21 ms, max residual 0.33 ms, integrity ok) is stronger evidence for the offset than the first-16-packet forward prediction. A single early packet at 113 vs 121 ms is muxer jitter; it does not move alignment, because every frame matched.
conditions: pts_anchor cites only what holds: 'whole-stream verify match at +21 ms (max residual 0.33 ms); first-16 forward prediction failed at video packet 11 (113 vs 121 ms)'
recorded as a lead decision in the lane note, and included in the post-landing review
